Name: Curves Of Affection
Author: Tyr4nTX
Description:
[color=#f4cccc][size=5][b]Love is in the AIR in the Valley!!
[/b][/size][/color]

This mod is a long dream of mine, because i really like changing things...! So here we are its a really big MOD, i know! BUT it s because its really much in it! 

So whats this mod about ? BASIC: It s a simple Portrait replacer mod... but with two twists... 1. The Portraits are fully animated! ( But not as big as my other mod, because this would be toooo big to download..) and 2. more importanly you get 6 different skins for your Bachelorettes! Because theire bustsizes grow with Heart levels: 

2❤️ → first swell
4❤️ → bouncy upgrade
6❤️ → cleavage chaos
8❤️ → heavy danger zone
10❤️ → exploding final form!

Additionally: I build some extra dialogue! So for every "Increasment" there is a special dialoge with a special Expression!! ;) 

AND because : and the reason WHY i did this mod was: i got several messages "make the boobs smalller/ bigger" .. Everyone has a different taste. sooo I implemented some GMCM Options....

On Default everything is like growing on 2 hearts for the bachelorettes.... 

but if you like one skin or bustsize you can toggle that in the option! You don t even have to grind for hearts! The choice is yours! 

PS. here the reason why this mod is so big: Haley got 14 natives Expression so her Portrait sheets contains 14 Portraits! With my mod you got 14x6= 84 different Haley Expression! plus 5 because of the special expression when the body changes ! 

There will be bugs and its Obvisouly AI ! So report me if you find something off! 

No you have another reason to talk and make present to your favourite Valley Girl!!!! 

Just install it like you normally would.

You need Smapi
Content Patcher
GMCM 
You need my APF Framework
